thread:
julie_csm: Heads-up: BeaconHealth flagged March SLA. Their renewal call is next week. Can we get final uptime + latency report and credit calc by EOD? @kevin_eng @amy_ops @mike_finance

kevin_eng: On it. I saw some retries in us-east during 2026-03-05 03:00-03:20 UTC. Seems like autoscaler flapped. Pulling metrics now.

amy_ops: I'll pull the per-region p95/p99 and the incident timeline. Tagging @sla-bot to generate baseline numbers.

sla-bot: Report generated: BeaconHealth - Mar 2026
Uptime: 99.93% (SLA 99.95%)
p95 latency (text-gen): 230ms (SLO 200ms)
p99 latency: 510ms (SLO 500ms)
Possible credit: yes (partial)

kevin_eng: Confirming - p95 spike caused by queuing during a 12-min scale event. Root cause: launcher restarted due to kernel OOM on one host. Patch ready to roll.

julie_csm: Thanks. Mike, if uptime < SLA do we auto-apply credits or need account approval?

mike_finance: We auto-issue per T&C if monthly uptime < SLA. Need final % and rounded credit amount. Finance will sign off on exceptions.

sam_sales: Heads-up: BeaconHealth is mid-renewal. If we don't proactively communicate and offer a credit, they might push back. Recommend: proactive note + postmortem + 1-month credit.

amy_ops: Attaching quick summary for customer message:

```text
Mar uptime: 99.93% (SLA 99.95%) => credit 0.5% of monthly bill
P95: 230ms vs 200ms (investigating)
Root cause: transient autoscaler instability in us-east; fix scheduled
Action: immediate credit + follow-up postmortem + reserved capacity offer for stability
```

kevin_eng: Q: do we need timeframe for fix? We can patch tonight and monitor; full host reprovisions done by tomorrow.

julie_csm: OK. Plan: mike to compute credit and issue, amy to send customer note (draft below), kevin to deploy fix, and I'll set renewal call to reassure. @mike_finance @kevin_eng

mike_finance: I'll calculate credit and confirm tx. Expect confirmation by 17:00 UTC.

julie_csm: Draft note (short):

'Thanks for flagging. In March we missed the 99.95% uptime SLA (actual: 99.93%). We are issuing a 0.5% credit for March while we complete a fix for the autoscaler root cause. We'll send a short postmortem by Friday and schedule a technical deep-dive if you'd like.'

Thoughts?

sam_sales: :thumbsup: Looks good. Maybe offer 30-min tech Q&A during renewal.

kevin_eng: Deploying patch now. I'll post update when monitoring shows stabilization.

julie_csm: Thanks team. I'll prep renewal talking points and send calendar invite for Friday. Marking this resolved for now; reopen if any updates.
